summary: The proof is complete and correct. The residual strip strictly implies B<1+A; the column-sum and height-sum identities force the three closed endpoint halfplanes to cover the affine plane; planar Grünbaum applies to the nondegenerate endpoint triangle at its centroid; and the exact one-positive zero-cap formula in the chamber p,a,b>0, p>a+b yields a strict cap fraction above 4/9. These bounds combine in one row to give the claimed strict gap, and the reasoning is invariant under the stated row permutations, common column permutations, and positive scalings.
